goal: Minimize reasoning dead time without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving disposable-worker semantics.

layers.mechanism: Current owner checkpoints meaningful work and emits one next-generation event on dedicated PR lane before observed early-runtime boundary.
layers.gate: Triggered Work worker must expose the same write-capable GitHub plugin/actions and the event trigger must expose PR commit updates.

layers.target_latency: <=5m schedule interval plus GitHub/Work delivery delay
layers.mechanism: Public-repo GitHub Actions emits a public-safe commit update to the dedicated PR lane every 5 minutes during bounded experiments.
layers.gate: Triggered Work worker must still be able to persist RRuleR durable state; pulse workflow must be bounded and storm-safe.

layers.target_latency: <=15m experimental phase rotation plus scheduler delay
layers.mechanism: Existing canonical ChatGPT scheduled task rotates BYMINUTE across quarter phases.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
wake event alone never advances authority
no secrets in public event lane
quarter fallback remains enabled until faster layers prove safe

capability_evidence.current_chat_github_connector: WRITE_CAPABLE: this run created/updated/deleted repository files, branches and draft PR #1.
capability_evidence.plugin_permission_setting: GitHub plugin reports app-specific permission 'Allow all actions' with no confirmation required.
capability_evidence.official_standard_github_app_doc: Standard GitHub app documentation still describes normal repository access as read-only for analysis/search.
capability_evidence.interpretation: There is credible account-level write capability, but product-surface parity is not guaranteed. The remaining question is whether an event-triggered Work invocation receives the same write-capable plugin/action surface.

current_blocker: Event-triggered Work write/action-surface parity is unproven, not known absent.
next_test: Bounded capability test: provision the GitHub PR event trigger and have the triggered Work invocation perform one harmless isolated lab write. If it succeeds without per-generation manual approval, proceed to the three-generation chain; otherwise reject self-chaining and test the independent 5-minute pulse only if a durable-write path remains available.
